text.text_excerpt: This is one of my all-time favorite New Orleans places. My dad used to get kicked out of this place for being too rowdy with his friends in the early 1960's and has been going ever since. ;-) I've been going my whole life- and it hasnt changed much since the late 1970's (as far back as I can remember). EVERYTHING is good here, but the frozen beers and the onion rings are the best. The po-boys are good, and the frenchuletta is awesome. The fried seafood is good too. I usually get the fried pickles too (which I love). If you are coming to New Orleans and want to go to a REAL New Orleans place, go here. REAL New Orleans people dont eat in the French Quarter for casual dining. They go to neig...

I will go the extra step and say 4 stars. I havent had a bad meal here. Only problem is I get the same damn thing everytime. Meatball poboy with mozz. MMmmmmm! I have sneaked a bite of red beans before and it was good. The ice cold chalice of beer at 11am is always a joy too. I have been lucky that I visit when the crowd has thinned out. Good thing because I take up alot of space and bumping people with my belly isnt my idea of fun. The tables are tight is what I am trying to say. The prices are IMHO kinda high, but in this area if I am in the mood for a solid New Orleans meal and not a fancier fare down the street at Katies, its hard to pass Liuzza's up. One of my favorite places in this city! This place is frequented by my family on Friday nights. It's where we go to get our Friday night seafood fix, and it is so good and always consistent. Old school New Orleans style in this joint! Love the seafood gumbo and I'm pretty picky about gumbo. Really good Italian food too, love the eggplant parm.
